document_metadata.document_title: New Hampshire Model Stormwater Standards / NH Stormwater Manual (city regs)

design_criteria.water_quality_volume_method: WQV = (P)(Rv)(A) where P = 1 inch of rainfall, Rv = 0.05 + 0.9(I), A = total site area draining to the structure (NH Model Stormwater Standards / NH Stormwater Manual). Manchester Sewer & Stormwater regulations implement NHDES post-construction standards consistent with this manual.

evidence.excerpt: Manchester Stormwater Regulations implement NHDES / NH Stormwater Manual standards
WQV = (P)(Rv)(A) where P = 1 inch of rainfall

evidence.page_or_section: Table 1. Stormwater Infrastructure Design Criteria, pages 10-11

evidence.excerpt: onsite retention of the first 1-inch of rainfall based on hydrologic soil group (HSG)
enhanced stormwater SCMs (such as raingardens, bioretention systems, tree box filters, and similar stormwater management landscaping techniques)
GIS files containing the coordinates of all stormwater infrastructure elements (e.g. catch basins, swales, detention/bioretention areas, piping)
subsurface gravel wetlands for water quality treatment is preferred

extraction_quality.review_notes: Municipality coverage via NH Model Stormwater Standards (2025 update). City also posts local Stormwater Regulations PDF.

design_parameters.enrich_notes: Manchester adopts NH Model Stormwater Standards (May 2025 draft). WQV uses P=1 inch per Table 1; WPS requires first 1-inch onsite retention by HSG (page 4). SCM sizing references UNH Stormwater Center tool and NH Stormwater Manual for BMP-specific design—not reproduced in these excerpts. GRV recharge depths by HSG (A 0.40, B 0.25, C 0.10, D 0.00 in) are recharge volumes, not WQV depth.
